brief.summary_1line: As Sita insists on sharing Rama’s exile, Dasaratha laments Kaikeyi’s cruelty and Rama asks his father to care for his mother Kaushalya during his absence.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita stands in bark garments before the court like a widow while the gathered citizens murmur and King Dasaratha looks on in anguish.
Overcome with grief after lamenting Kaikeyi’s demand, King Dasaratha collapses to the ground in the royal hall.
Rama, head bowed before his father, gently asks the king to protect his grieving mother Kaushalya during his exile.
